membership.algorithm: proportional largest-remainder within each joint label stratum, seeded shuffle and deterministic repair to exact sizes; no predictions

recipe.physics_aware_p050: clean .5 + one uniform draw from RA_LL/RA_LA/LA_LL physical reversals .5
recipe.combined: clean .5 + uniform five-lead mask .25 + one uniform draw from RA_LL/RA_LA/LA_LL reversal .25; never combined
recipe.mask: uniform lexicographic C(12,5)=792; raw train per-lead mean sentinel
recipe.loss: weighted multilabel BCE, train-only pos_weight cap20
recipe.checkpoint: best selection TWA AUPRC; earliest tie
recipe.normalization: per displayed lead mean/std from unchanged train only

selection: only model_selection TWA AUPRC; no A/B access; early stop patience 5
calibration: positive-slope sigmoid(a*logit(p)+b); A clean scores only, unweighted log loss, per method/seed/endpoint
threshold: B clean negative raw q90; use A fit for calibrated operating threshold; no fitting now
huang: frozen detector -> predicted inverse on incoming damaged ECG -> corresponding NEW ordinary classifier; same separate A/B roles, own pipeline scores; zero additional training; reuse detector cache only with verified input/order/class/checkpoint bindings; recovery-v2 handoff regression required
failure: one-class/nonfinite/solver failure stops affected endpoint; no fallback; primary TWA failure or any model selection/integrity gate failure closes test; preserve negative scientific outcomes

calibration_numerics.raw_q90_quantile_method: numpy linear; freeze score/threshold precision before inference
calibration_numerics.primary_operating_decisions: raw score >= raw B q90; calibrated threshold is its mapped value; report clipping/saturation decision differences explicitly, no outcome-driven threshold adjustment

future_eval.rule: only after all fits lock; no outcome-based choices

claims: separation of roles for new checkpoint runs at record level; not untouched research history, patient-disjoint or new independent external replication. Comparison with historical outputs also changes checkpoint selection and calibration sample sizes; it does not isolate a causal effect or quantify historical calibration bias.

budget.caveat: Projection from similar runs, not new measurement; exact p050 runtime and future load unknown; excludes future inference/calibration/evaluation/bootstrap.
budget.additional_compute: Up to 270 selection-validation passes × 1,744 records = 470,880 record presentations during training; 15,696 clean diagnostic score rows for A/B (9 checkpoints × 1,744). Core methods require 27 endpoint Platt fits and 27 negative-q90 selections. Huang adds 5,232 diagnostic A/B score rows (3 seeds × 1,744), 9 Platt fits and 9 q90 selections: 36 fits/selections total. Detector inputs required only if verified caches cannot bind. Future test/HEEDB scoring excluded and not run.

regressions: best epoch argmax/earliest tie on selection only
all split counts/hash/overlap and source train/test intersections
Platt A-only and q90 B-only, frozen numerical failures
test/HEEDB gate closed until all locks
